title: Framework auto-instrumentation
one_line: Record LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI and AutoGen runs with no handler code.
verified_against: Handlers tested against stub framework objects. A smoke test against the real packages (patch points exist, undo restores them) runs only in a CI lane that installs the framework extras. No live model calls.
snippet:
import briefcase

briefcase.observe()   # destination from the environment
briefcase.auto()      # every installed framework and provider SDK
